title: Device answer, version 1
description: A participant's answer to a device query: its plan, the plan's private cost (everything except the electricity bill: discomfort, wear, energy left in store, a missed goal) and its state trajectory, one point longer than the plan.

plan_kw.description: kW per slot, positive when drawn from the meter

trajectory.description: state per point (n + 1 for n slots), in the participant's own unit
